Once a network and a demand file exist, a `.sumocfg` file ties them together. You can run the
simulation headless from the command line for speed, or open it in **sumo-gui** — the interface
this site's chrome is modeled on — to watch traffic move through the network.

::: {.callout-note title="Key concepts"}
- Play / Pause / Step advance the simulation clock
- The delay slider slows playback so fast simulations are easier to watch
- `tripinfo-output` logs each vehicle's travel time, waiting time, and route length
- Coloring schemes can shade vehicles or edges by speed, occupancy, or fuel use
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Tip"}
Run a short simulation first to sanity-check your setup before scaling up to a full day of
demand.
:::
